title: Mother and Toddler at Crowded Beach, 1950 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A classic post-war black and white snapshot capturing a mother standing beside her young child sitting on an inflatable inner tube right at the water's edge. In the background, numerous beachgoers and swimmers dot the rolling ocean waves under bright daylight. A blue handwritten date along the lower margin reads '9- 1950', reflecting the era's booming American beach culture and family leisure time. The print features a traditional deckled edge border.
